findings.evidence: packages/connectors/src/import-pocket/index.ts:292-326 returns one SyncBatch of every row (MAX_RECORDS=1000000). packages/core/src/ingest/run.ts:121-124,486-489 refuses batches with more than MAX_SYNC_BATCH_EVENTS=1000 or MAX_SYNC_BATCH_BYTES=4MiB. Health/enrollment only reads the first CSV header line (index.ts:260-278).
findings.expected: Public enrollment reports, or the importer itself, must not imply that a legal whole-export parse will capture. Independently: a 1001-row well-formed Pocket CSV enrolls with health=ok and then capture errors with 'sync batch exceeds 1000 events'.
findings.affected: P078 capture/docs must state the host 1000-event/4MiB/60s bounds; catalog/doctor currently omit them.

findings.expected: Catalog truthfully names a local archived CSV import, not a live Pocket service.

P003/P015/Astra/doctor owners unchanged.
